sections.content: An awkward conversation may involve direct communication, reported speech, implied meaning and clarification. Combine these structures to explain what happened and how people interpreted it.

items.spanish: Pensé que estaba enfadada, pero explicó que estaba cansada.
items.english: I thought she was angry, but she explained that she was tired.
What did he mean by that?

items.spanish: Lo que quería decir era que necesitábamos hablar.
items.english: What she meant was that we needed to talk.

sections.content: When explaining an interaction, distinguish what was said, what was meant and how it was interpreted.
